raw_segments.text: For a moment, with the fear of my sisters working me before my eyes, I had a desperate
idea of starting round the room in the assumed character of Mr. Pumblechook's chaise cart.
But I felt myself so unequal to the performance that I gave it up, and stood looking at Miss
Havisham in what I suppose she took for a dogged manner, inasmuch as she said, when
we had taken a good look at each other.
